Hero_Desc_Kishya:
Kishya is a ghostly underground idol who dreams of becoming the greatest in Elias.
Driven purely by her desire to perform, she is an unusual ghost who appears only in underground venues.
She calls her few supporters a 'handful of fans,' but treasures every fan who watches her.
Album_Hobby_Kishya: Shopping for stage props and costumes
Album_Wish_Kishya: To become Elias's ultimate underground idol
Album_Kishya1: Kishya is Elias's first underground idol. She sparkles onstage, but perhaps because of her forceful personality, she has few fans. Even so, her job satisfaction seems unmatched.
Album_Kishya2: Several other underground idols appeared after Kishya, but they do not seem close. She especially believes idols from large agencies lack individuality. Sometimes she also seems a little envious...
Album_Kishya3: Kishya is easy to encounter in the shopping district. Wanting to show her fans something new every time, she chooses a fresh concept for each performance... though she sometimes buys props and costumes whose purpose is utterly mysterious.
Album_Kishya4: Other underground idols perform in groups, but Kishya says solo work suits her better. She claimed there would be no solution if her overwhelming talent overshadowed her teammates, though she looked quietly proud of the prospect.
Album_Kishya5: Kishya occasionally visits internet cafes. She has little aptitude for games and rarely plays, but finds darknet conversations interesting and mostly lurks. Posts praising Kishya appear regularly, and she says the author is obvious without asking.
Album_Kishya6: Sometimes Kishya appears to enjoy meeting and communicating with fans as much as performing. She says she is merely immersed in the role of a fan-loving underground idol, but the way she thinks of them even in private shows genuine affection.
Album_Kishya7: Kishya says she now spends more time wondering how to make her handful of fans happier. She seems to hope they can move beyond idol and fan, growing closer and supporting one another for a long time.
LoveHero_Kishya: Yahoo~! I knew I was your favorite underground idol~!
LoveHeroCancel_Kishya: H-Hmph! You will obviously come back to me someday!
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Hate1: Kishya glared suspiciously at the misutgaru and took a sip. She complained that it was merely dry and had neither flavor nor charm.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Hate2: She complained that attention-starved underground idols only pretended to enjoy it. A fake drink for fake-smiling idols, or something like that.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like1: She excitedly said that even a peel could not conceal jewel-bright flesh, making it just like Kishya herself.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like10: She exclaimed that the taste made her happy enough to perform immediately, if only the banquet hall were not already so bright.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like2: Kishya studied the gold leaf closely, happily discussing how to incorporate it into the styling for her next stage.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like3: At first, she dismissed the plain white soup as bland and uninteresting. After one spoonful, she was too busy chewing to say anything else.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like4: Kishya said it was a flavor she wanted to share with her handful of fans. She was overjoyed when I suggested bringing them all next time.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like5: Kishya said it would be perfect before a performance, not only because it tasted good but because its intense tartness immediately woke her up.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like6: Kishya marveled at the colorful songpyeon. She found it impressive how so many bold colors gathered together while each displayed its own individuality.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like7: Saying the almond rocher was delicious, Kishya placed one in my mouth too. Somehow, I seemed to be the one receiving the reward...
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like8: Kishya energetically declared that eating this would let her sing three songs without lip-syncing.
Food_ChefNote_Kishya_Like9: Kishya happily said it would make a perfect light snack whenever her blood sugar fell after a performance.

LoveLetter_Kishya:
Hello, Master! The future greatest underground idol in Elias wrote this letter just for you!
You know, lately I smile every day just thinking about my fans! I cannot stop remembering that people cheer so passionately for me!

How are you, Master? How was your day? Was it terribly exhausting?
At times like that, do not forget that I am here!
Just as you are my very own good fan, always remember that I am your fan too~!
LoveCall_Kishya:
Master, yahoo~ What were you doing?
Are you very busy? Is that why you have not come to my shows lately?
I kept waiting... Without your cheers, I have no energy.
You are my very, very good fan. You have not started disliking me, right?

Actually, I called to ask what concept I should use for my next performance.
What kind of me do you want to see?
If you are too embarrassed to say now, you can leave me a message later.

So, Master, I want you to visit me more often.
If you do not, I will be very, very upset!
Now I am going shopping for my next outfit! Bye, Master!
Affinity_Kishya_EP01_001: I want to hold this fan meeting in the Banquet Hall!
Affinity_Kishya_EP01_002: No. Other people eat here too.
Affinity_Kishya_EP01_003: Aww...! That is so unfair! If people come to eat and have a fan meeting with me too, is that not killing two birds with one stone?!
Affinity_Kishya_EP01_005: The fan meeting we held while everyone ate hangover soup last time was so much fun! If we hold another one like that, the Banquet Hall is perfect!
Affinity_Kishya_EP01_006: All right. Just do not make it too noisy.
Affinity_Kishya_EP01_007: Hehe, thank you! Since you provided the venue, I will give Master a cheek shot with my handwritten autograph, just for you!
Affinity_Kishya_EP02_001: What should the next outfit concept be?
Affinity_Kishya_EP02_002: How about a brand-new concept of your own that you have never tried before?
Affinity_Kishya_EP02_003: A new concept that is mine alone... It is vague, but somehow exciting! I like it! I will develop a new concept!
Affinity_Kishya_EP02_006: Is it not more comfortable to stick with what you always do?
Affinity_Kishya_EP02_007: That may be true, but I cannot show my fans the same side of me forever! I have to show them all my different charms!
Affinity_Kishya_EP03_001: Next time I want to perform with an original new song of my own instead of a cover!
Affinity_Kishya_EP03_002: Did an underground idol even release a song?
Affinity_Kishya_EP03_003: Cover songs are usually the norm, but now I want a song that can convey my feelings directly!
Affinity_Kishya_EP03_004: That sounds good. The fans will like it too.
Affinity_Kishya_EP03_005: Yes! I will put my feelings for my fans into it and write the lyrics myself!
Affinity_Kishya_EP03_006: Should I ask the musicians to help you?
Affinity_Kishya_EP03_007: No, I do not need that. It might improve the stage quality, but it would dilute the title of having an original song that is mine alone!
Affinity_Kishya_EP04_001: How much is a cheek shot with Master? I want one too!
Affinity_Kishya_EP04_002: I do not take cheek shots.
Affinity_Kishya_EP04_003: What do you mean, cheek shots? My fans love them! Someday Master will fall for the charm of cheek shots too!
Affinity_Kishya_EP04_004: Have you not taken plenty with your fans already?
Affinity_Kishya_EP04_005: We only take them together; the photos all belong to the fans. I want at least one cheek shot with my own fan too!
Affinity_Kishya_EP04_006: I am not planning to sell it. If you want one, let us take one together.
Affinity_Kishya_EP04_007: Really?! I wanted a cheek shot too. Thank you! Hehe, I think I am becoming Master's fan!
Affinity_Kishya_EP05_001: I want to make merchandise that my fans will like!
Affinity_Kishya_EP05_002: What kind of merchandise do you want to make?
Affinity_Kishya_EP05_003: Hmm~ That is what I am trying to decide! A plushie? A photocard? A key ring? Master! Which sounds best?!
Affinity_Kishya_EP05_004: Would it not be hard to manage if you sold merchandise too?
Affinity_Kishya_EP05_005: It might be a little hard. But when I imagine my fans being happy, the hard part does not matter anymore!
Affinity_Kishya_EP05_006: Really? The fans will like it. I will help too.
Affinity_Kishya_EP05_007: Master...! Thank you! When the new merchandise comes out, I will give the very first one to Master!
Affinity_Kishya_EP06_001: I am planning a one-on-one date event with my fans. What do you think?
Affinity_Kishya_EP06_003: We will draw lots, and the winning fan gets to spend the whole day going out and having fun with me! What do you think? Everyone will love it, right?!
Affinity_Kishya_EP06_004: Sounds good. I should apply too.
Affinity_Kishya_EP06_005: Hehe, really?! The drawing will be fair, but... I will hope Master wins!
Affinity_Kishya_EP06_006: Pira is going to get tired...
Affinity_Kishya_EP06_007: That is only natural for my manager! Besides, my increased income is good for Pira too!
Affinity_Kishya_EP07_001: Is there anything different about me today?
Affinity_Kishya_EP07_002: I think I know... Could you give me a hint?
Affinity_Kishya_EP07_003: A hint...? So you do not know, right? Well, I will give you credit for trying to figure it out. Now look closely at my face!
Affinity_Kishya_EP07_004: Hmm? Ah, did your eye makeup change a little? It suits you.
Affinity_Kishya_EP07_005: Hehe, I knew you would notice! As expected, Master is the fan who understands me best!
Affinity_Kishya_EP07_007: Ugh... Look more carefully! The base color of my eyeshadow is darker!
Affinity_Kishya_EP08_001: Ugh, games really are not for me. I keep losing, and the other team teases me. It is no fun!
Affinity_Kishya_EP08_002: How about making content where you play games with your fans?
Affinity_Kishya_EP08_003: Whoa! That is a great idea! If I am with my fans, even losing several games in a row will be fun!
Affinity_Kishya_EP08_004: Then why not just stop playing?
Affinity_Kishya_EP08_005: That is true, but when my fans talk about games, I want to be able to add a few words too.
Affinity_Kishya_EP08_007: Ugh, you are right. Debuting as an underground idol was incredibly difficult too! I will try again next time!
Affinity_Kishya_EP09_001: I think choosing Pira as my manager was the right decision.
Affinity_Kishya_EP09_002: Be careful. You never know when she might run off with your money.
Affinity_Kishya_EP09_003: Huh? She would not! ...Of course, she does ask me to raise her salary a little whenever we settle the accounts.
Affinity_Kishya_EP09_004: That is good. I think you two make a pretty good match too.
Affinity_Kishya_EP09_005: Exactly! With Pira's star-powered management, becoming Elias's greatest underground idol is not far away!
Affinity_Kishya_EP09_006: Really? That is unexpected. I was a little worried.
Affinity_Kishya_EP09_007: She may be a little careless, but she is doing a good enough job. She is not just some third-rate thug!
Affinity_Kishya_EP10_001: I wish there were a groundbreaking way to promote a performance.
Affinity_Kishya_EP10_002: How about a collaboration with the Order next time?
Affinity_Kishya_EP10_003: Oh! That sounds good! Then Master can be my partner for my first collaboration performance!
Affinity_Kishya_EP10_004: What happened to handing out flyers with Pira?
Affinity_Kishya_EP10_005: U-um... We handed them out all right, but seeing my face rolling around on the ground hurts a little...
Affinity_Kishya_EP10_006: Do you really need more promotion?
Affinity_Kishya_EP10_007: Of course! Promotion is essential if I am going to become Elias's greatest underground idol!
Affinity_Kishya_EP11_001: What side of me do my fans like?
Affinity_Kishya_EP11_003: W-wait? What are you saying all of a sudden, Master! Am I really that cute? Why did you never tell me!!
Affinity_Kishya_EP11_005: Exactly! I think so too! What if I lip-sync a little? Nobody beats me when it comes to passion!
Affinity_Kishya_EP11_007: S-shamelessness?! I cannot say that is completely wrong... Is that why they like me? It feels a little strange.
Affinity_Kishya_EP12_001: I bought too many stage outfits and am on the verge of bankruptcy...
Affinity_Kishya_EP12_003: But going onstage in the same outfit every day would be boring! Master does not understand me!
Affinity_Kishya_EP12_005: About twenty, I guess? Are you curious? Should I show Master first? Hmm?
Affinity_Kishya_EP12_006: The fans will still like it.
Affinity_Kishya_EP12_007: Of course! Is Master such a huge fan that you understand me so well? Master, yahoo~
Affinity_Kishya_EP13_001: Master! Want to go to karaoke with me later?
Affinity_Kishya_EP13_002: Would that not be a private meeting?
Affinity_Kishya_EP13_003: Master, why are you being so strict? If Master pays all the Gold, that makes it even!
Affinity_Kishya_EP13_005: Hmm~ Would they? Then we can invite all the fans to come along!
Affinity_Kishya_EP13_007: Right? I will sing all the songs, so Master only has to clap! Do not take the microphone!
Affinity_Kishya_EP14_002: You must have practiced a lot.
Affinity_Kishya_EP14_003: Of course! If an underground idol as talented as me works hard too, I will become even more perfect!
Affinity_Kishya_EP14_004: Take a little break from tomorrow's performance.
Affinity_Kishya_EP14_005: What?! Take a break? Does Master not want to see my performance? Disappointed, disappointed~ So disappointed!
Affinity_Kishya_EP14_006: Rest a little while eating something delicious.
Affinity_Kishya_EP14_007: Wow~ My Master is such a kind fan! As expected, you get the fan that matches the underground idol!
Affinity_Kishya_EP15_001: Hey, I got a call from a TV station yesterday asking me to appear.
Affinity_Kishya_EP15_003: Exactly! I do not want to appear on some fake show like that either. We really understand each other, right?
Affinity_Kishya_EP15_004: Are you not becoming too famous?
Affinity_Kishya_EP15_005: I do not particularly want to become famous. I am having plenty of fun as I am!
Affinity_Kishya_EP15_006: What kind of show is it?
Affinity_Kishya_EP15_007: Some kind of oddball talk show? It is a waste-of-time program that gathers strange people and has them compete over who is strangest!
Affinity_Kishya_EP16_001: I baked bread myself for my fans!
Affinity_Kishya_EP16_003: Hehe! Even without asking, I made Master's extra~ large! Master is my biggest fan!
Affinity_Kishya_EP16_005: Yes, yes! That is exactly what I wanted to hear! I am the only underground idol who excels at her main job and loves her fans this much!
Affinity_Kishya_EP16_006: It smells like something is burning...
Affinity_Kishya_EP16_007: Is my devotion not more important than the taste? Just close your eyes and endure this much!!
Affinity_Kishya_EP17_001: I took photos for a photobook this time! I will sell it together with the cheek shots!
Affinity_Kishya_EP17_002: It is a normal photo book, right?
Affinity_Kishya_EP17_003: Hmm? Master, what are you thinking about? You are not thinking about anything naughty, are you?!
Affinity_Kishya_EP17_005: Do not worry. I have a special photobook just for Master... Hehe!
Affinity_Kishya_EP17_006: How much could that possibly cost?
Affinity_Kishya_EP17_007: Limited editions sold in small quantities are what make things cool, so it is a little expensive. Do not buy it if you think the Gold is a waste!
Affinity_Kishya_EP18_001: I have a new fan! I think she is one of the Apostles...
Affinity_Kishya_EP18_003: Ah~ That cute witch? She looks sparkly and adorable, so I wish she were my fan... but it is not her.
Affinity_Kishya_EP18_005: What? No way! It is lucky enough if she does not chase me down demanding the installment payments for my outfits...
Affinity_Kishya_EP18_007: Yes, that is right!! She likes me so much that she even came wearing a cherry-red outfit! Opal, yahoo~
Affinity_Kishya_EP19_001: Pira gets really happy whenever the Dance Assassin comes!
Affinity_Kishya_EP19_003: Why are you suddenly taking her side? That Dance Assassin... I wish she would stop challenging me!
Affinity_Kishya_EP19_004: Your thoughts are written all over your face...
Affinity_Kishya_EP19_005: It cannot be helped. Pira is only happy when she is sitting on a mountain of money. Everyone just has different standards!
Affinity_Kishya_EP19_006: As long as you two are happy...
Affinity_Kishya_EP19_007: Well~ She takes quite a lot of Gold, but I think even the Dance Assassin is enjoying it now. That is good enough!
Affinity_Kishya_EP20_001: You will always be my good fan, right, Master?
Affinity_Kishya_EP20_002: You do not say that to everyone, do you?
Affinity_Kishya_EP20_003: Th-that is a trade secret! Master... Are you jealous? I will let it slide because it is cute.
Affinity_Kishya_EP20_004: I do not know whether I am a good one, but I will be your fan.
Affinity_Kishya_EP20_005: All my fans are~ good fans. Then we will stay together for a long, long time, right? Hmm? Promise!
Affinity_Kishya_EP20_006: Until you stop being an underground idol?
Affinity_Kishya_EP20_007: What? So you will stop being my fan if I am no longer an underground idol? I hate you, Master!
Apology_Kishya: I will work even harder from now on! S-so please do not switch to another underground idol!
